gloss: Omotesenke; a major school of Japanese tea ceremony

definitions.gloss: Omotesenke; a major school of Japanese tea ceremony
definitions.explanation: One of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony, tracing its lineage directly back to the tea master Sen no Rikyu through the main line of the Sen family. Known for a reticent, understated style of preparing matcha, and for reading the word {茶道|さどう} as さどう rather than ちゃどう.

examples.english: I'm studying tea ceremony at Omotesenke.

examples.english: Omotesenke is a school directly descended from Sen no Rikyu.

examples.english: Omotesenke and Urasenke both descend from the same Sen family, but their tea-preparation procedures differ slightly.

notes:
{表千家|おもてせんけ} is one of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony ({三千家|さんせんけ}), tracing its lineage directly back to the tea master {千利休|せんのりきゅう} through the Sen family's main house.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Among the Sen family schools, {表千家|おもてせんけ} reads ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ as さどう, while ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：30918_urasenke⟧ reads it as ちゃどう - a small but well-known difference among practitioners.
